title: Identity and composition for the input quotient reductions
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, with $A_n=\mathcal O_E/(\varpi^{n+1})$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $W$ be any scheme, let $\widehat R_W$ be its completed coefficient sheaf on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and let $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(\widehat R_W))$ be arbitrary [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Use exactly the normalized quotient arrows $\rho_{m,n}:K_m\to\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}K_n$ of [def-coef-compact-support-reduction-maps], and the restriction identifications $i_n,c_{r,m,n}$ of [lem-coef-compact-support-quotient-coordinates]. Then $\rho_{n,n};i_n=1$ for all $n$, and $\rho_{r,m};\operatorname{Res}_{r,m}(\rho_{m,n});c_{r,m,n}=\rho_{r,n}$ for $n\leq m\leq r$. There is no geometric functor, compactification, constructibility, boundedness or Tor assumption.

proof.text: On the same $P$, the map for $m=n$ is the identity because $q_{n,n}=1$. For $r\geq m\geq n$, both the direct quotient map and the composite through $m$ send $x\otimes u$ to $x\otimes q_{m,n}(q_{r,m}(u))=x\otimes q_{r,n}(u)$. These equalities hold for local pure tensors, hence on the sheaf tensors and complexes. Applying derived localization and using Step 2 proves $\rho_{n,n}=1$ and $\rho_{r,n}=\operatorname{Res}_{r,m}(\rho_{m,n})\rho_{r,m}$ with the stated restriction-composition identifications.

theorem compactSupportQuotient_input_laws (W : Scheme.{u})
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E W)) :
    (∀ n : ℕ, compactSupportQuotientNativeMap l E W n n le_rfl K ≫
      (compactSupportQuotientNativeResId l E W n).hom.app
        ((compactSupportQuotientNativeLevel l E W n).obj K) = 𝟙 _) ∧
    (∀ (r m n : ℕ) (hrm : m ≤ r) (hmn : n ≤ m),
      compactSupportQuotientNativeMap l E W r m hrm K ≫
          (compactSupportQuotientNativeRestriction l E W r m hrm).map
              (compactSupportQuotientNativeMap l E W m n hmn K) ≫
          (compactSupportQuotientNativeResComp l E W r m n hrm hmn).hom.app
            ((compactSupportQuotientNativeLevel l E W n).obj K) =
        compactSupportQuotientNativeMap l E W r n (hmn.trans hrm) K)
